blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate frames based on new observations and inputs, making them a promising medium for interactive visual experiences. However, existing models are orders of magnitude too slow for fluid interaction. This paper introduces FastFrames, a family of fast autoregressive video diffusion models that achieves interactive latency without compromising quality. We profile the inference pipeline of state-of-the-art models and find that operations often treated as fixed implementation details, such as VAE decoding and KV cache updates, in fact account for over half of end-to-end inference latency. We challenge the assumption that these components are indispensable and replace them with lightweight alternatives. Our 1.3B variant runs at 36 ms per frame, or 28 responses per second (RPS), on a single B200 GPU while matching the generation quality of a state-of-the-art model that is nearly 8x slower. Our 14B variant runs at 45 ms per frame, or 22 RPS, on an 8x B200 GPU node and yields significantly better visual quality and realism. We show that FastFrames enables real-time interaction in applications such as camera-conditioned and physics-conditioned video generation.
blocks.zh: 自动回转的视频传播模型基于新的观察和投入生成帧,使其成为互动视觉体验的有希望的媒介. 然而,现有的模型对于流体相互作用来说,数量级太慢了. 本文引入了FastFrames,一个由快自递式视频传播模型组成的家族,这些模型在不损害质量的情况下实现了互动性延缓. 我们剖析了最先进的模型的推论管道,并发现操作经常被作为固定执行细节处理,如VAE解码和KV缓存更新,事实上占了端到端推论延迟的一半以上. 我们对这些组成部分是不可或缺的假设提出质疑,并以轻量级替代品取而代之。 我们的1.3B变体运行在单个B200GPU上,每帧36ms,或每秒28个响应(RPS),同时匹配近8x慢的先进型号的生成质量. 我们的14B变体运行在一个8x B200 GPU节点上,每帧45ms,或22 RPS,并产生显著的更好的视觉质量和现实性. 我们显示 FastFrames 可以进行实时交互 应用,例如摄像机和物理设备的视频生成。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Video diffusion models ( Ho et al., 2022b ; Ho et al., 2022a ; Singer et al., 2023 ; Blattmann et al., 2023 ) synthesize realistic videos ( Wang et al., 2025 ; Seedance Team et al., 2026 ; Black Forest Labs, 2026 ; MiniMax, 2026 ) , compose diverse scenes and visual concepts ( Deng et al., 2026 ; Chou et al., 2025 ; Pan et al., 2026 ) , and respond to camera and action controls ( Wang et al., 2024 ; He et al., 2025 ) . In particular, autoregressive (AR) models ( Jin et al., 2025 ; Deng et al., 2025 ; Chen et al., 2025 ; Teng et al., 2025 ) generate videos incrementally, allowing them to incorporate new controls or observations.
They are a promising medium for interactive visual applications, such as world simulation ( Chou et al., 2026 ; Seo et al., 2026 ) , games ( Yu et al., 2025 ; Robbyant Team et al., 2026 ) , and predictive models for robotics ( Ye et al., 2026 ; NVIDIA, 2026 ) .
blocks.zh:
视频传播模型(Ho等人,2022b; Ho等人,2022a; Singer等,2023; Blattmann等,2023) 合成现实视频(Wang等,2025;Seedance Team等,2026;Black Forest Labs,2026;MiniMax等,2026;Deng等,2026;Chou等,2025;Pan等,2026),并回应相机和行动控制(Wang等,2024;He等,2025). 特别是自递(AR)模型(Jin等,2025;Deng等,2025;Chen等,2025;Teng等,2025)递增地生成视频,使其能纳入新的控制或观测.
它们是互动视觉应用的有希望的媒介,如:世界模拟(Chou等,2026;徐等,2026;游戏(Yu等,2025;Robbyant Team等,2026;))和机器人预测模型(Ye等,2026;NVIDIA,2026).

blocks.en:
Recent works have significantly accelerated AR video diffusion models, primarily through distillation and few-step sampling ( Yin et al., 2024a ; Yin et al., 2025 ) . Some now report real-time generation speeds based on frames per second (FPS) ( Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) .
However, FPS alone does not establish whether a model can respond to user inputs in real time. For instance, a model that generates a 30-frame clip as a single batch in one second achieves 30 FPS, but the user must still wait one second to see a response.
Seamless real-time interactivity demands low input-to-response latency, as established in interactive systems research ( Miller, 1968 ) . Human-computer interaction studies have reported delay-detection thresholds of approximately 50 to 60 ms ( Annett et al., 2014 ; Deber et al., 2015 ; Forch et al., 2017 ) .
blocks.zh:
最近的工作大大加快了AR视频传播模式,主要是通过蒸馏和几步取样(Yin等人,2024a; Yin等, 2025 (英语). 现在有人报告基于帧每秒(FPS)的实时生成速度(Huang等,2025;Zhu等,2026).
然而,单凭FPS并不能确定一个模型是否能够实时响应用户输入. 例如,一个在一秒内产生30帧剪辑作为单批的模型就达到了30个FPS,但用户仍然必须等一秒钟才能看到响应.
无缝实时交互需要低入-响应延迟,这是在交互式系统研究中确立的(Miller,1968.). 人类计算机交互研究报告称,延迟探测阈值约为50至60毫秒(Annett等人,2014年;Deber等人,2015年;Forch等人,2017年)。

blocks.en: Thus, we target end-to-end per-frame latency below 50 ms. We define this latency as the delay between the arrival of a new input signal (e.g., a steering command) and the presentation of the first RGB frame that depicts its effects. In the baseline methods we study ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhao et al., 2026a ) , the inference pipeline consists of KV cache updates, diffusion sampling, and pixel rendering. Measuring latency requires accounting for the complete critical path through these operations.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们的目标是50米以下的一端到一端间隔。 我们把这种延迟定义为从一个新的输入信号(例如方向指令)到介绍第一个描述其效果的RGB框架之间的延迟. 在我们研究的基准方法(Yin等,2025;Huang等,2025;Zhao等,2026a)中,推论管由KV缓存更新,扩散取样和像素渲染等组成. 要衡量延迟性,就必须说明这些行动的完整关键路径。

blocks.en:
To close this gap, we introduce FastFrames , a family of autoregressive video diffusion models that, to the best of our knowledge, is the first to take end-to-end per-frame latency into the interactive regime ( ≤ 50 \leq\!50 ms).
We analyze the limiting factors of existing models by profiling the critical inference path of a reference 1.3B-parameter model, a common model size that balances speed and generation quality
(Fig. 2 ). We find that dominant costs lie not in diffusion denoising steps, but rather in operations often treated as fixed implementation details, such as VAE decoding and KV cache updates. For instance, a single VAE decoding step takes as long as 3.5 DiT passes.
blocks.zh:
为了缩小这一差距,我们引入了FastFrames, 这是一种自相径庭的视频传播模式,
我们通过剖析参考1.3B参数模型的关键推论路径来分析现有模型的限制因素,这种模型的通用尺寸平衡了速度和生成质量.
(图2)我们发现,主导成本不在于扩散去诺步骤,而在于通常作为固定实施细节处理的操作,如VAE解码和KV缓存更新. 例如,一个单一的VAE解码步骤只需要3.5 DiT通过.

blocks.en:
We challenge the assumption that these components are indispensable and replace them with lightweight alternatives.
First, we replace the VAE decoder with a ConvNeXt-based ( Liu et al., 2022 ) head that operates only in low spatial resolution, followed by a single linear layer that unpatchifies and upsamples the latents to pixel dimensions, reducing decoding latency by 147× while matching quality.
Furthermore, because the head is lightweight, training the model end-to-end in pixel-space (e.g., perceptual ( Zhang et al., 2018 ) and GAN ( Goodfellow et al., 2014 ) losses) becomes practical, bypassing the reconstruction bottleneck of the VAE.
Second, the baseline inference pipeline includes an additional DiT evaluation on each fully denoised latent solely to refine the KV cache (Sec. 3.3 ); we replace the DiT evaluation with a lightweight network, reducing cache-update latency 10x without measurable degradation in quality.
Finally, we perform multiple system-level, hardware-aware optimizations that specifically target the end-to-end per-frame critical path.
Our techniques target components shared by many AR video diffusion models and are therefore complementary to advances in backbone architecture, such as hybrid transformers ( Chen et al., 2026a ) , and improved distillation methods ( Liu et al., 2026a ) .
blocks.zh:
我们对这些组成部分是不可或缺的假设提出质疑,并以轻量级替代品取而代之。
首先,将VAE解码器替换为基于ConvNEXt的(Liu等,2022年)头只以低空间分辨率运行,再用单线性地层来解析并给潜入到像素维度上做标本,在匹配质量的同时将解码空位降低147×.
此外,由于头部为轻量级,以像素-空间(如感官(张等,2018年)和GAN(Goodfellow等,2014年)亏损)来训练模型端到端也变得实用,绕过了VAE的重建瓶颈.
第二,基线推导管道包括对每个完全去名的潜伏进行额外的DiT评价,仅仅是为了改进KV缓存(第3.3条);我们用一个轻量级网络取代DiT评价,减少缓存更新后缀10x,而不会在质量上发生可测量的退化。
最后,我们进行多个系统级别,硬件意识优化,具体针对每帧端到端的关键路径.
我们的技术以许多AR视频传播模型共享的组件为目标,因此与骨干结构的进步,如混合变压器(Chen等,2026a)相补充,并改进了蒸馏方法(Liu等,2026a.).

blocks.en:
In the standard text-to-video (T2V) setting, where the model simply treats the current generated frame as input for generating the next, our quantitative and qualitative evaluations show that FastFrames establishes a new Pareto frontier between generation quality and speed (Fig. 1 ).
The 1.3B variant achieves an end-to-end per-frame latency of 36 ms (28 RPS) on a single B200 GPU at 832×480 resolution (480p), matching the visual quality of a state-of-the-art baseline ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) that is 7.6× slower. Scaling FastFrames to 14B improves visual fidelity while achieving 45 ms (22 RPS) on an 8× B200 GPU node.

1.3B变体以832×480分(480p)的分辨率在单个B200GPU上实现每帧的端到端间距为36 ms(28 RTS),与最先进的基线(Zhao等,2026a)的视觉质量相匹配,速度更慢. 将FastFrames放大到14B可以提高视觉的忠诚度,同时在一个8×B200 GPU节点上实现45ms(22 RPS).

The T2V AR pipeline can be extended to accept controls between generation steps, such as camera poses ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) , 2D tracks ( Shin et al., 2026 ) , and 3D dynamics ( Li et al., 2025b ) .
We show that FastFrames enables fluid interactive experiences in two applications: camera-conditioned and physics-conditioned video generation.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
Accelerating diffusion sampling. Diffusion models require iterative sampling ( Ho et al., 2020 ) . Earlier work reduces the number of sampling steps using training-free accelerated samplers ( Song et al., 2021 ; Lu et al., 2022 ; Lu et al., 2025 ) or by training models to take larger steps along their sampling trajectories ( Frans et al., 2025 ; Geng et al., 2025 ; Shaul et al., 2026 ) .
The state of the art relies on distribution matching ( Yin et al., 2024b ; Yin et al., 2024a ; Cui et al., 2026 ) , where a few-step student generator approximates the distribution of a teacher network.
Another line of work focuses on the inference cost of DiTs, including hybrid attention ( Li et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ) , sliding-window attention for long context ( Xiao et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) , and layer pruning or model-size distillation ( Fang et al., 2025a ; Wu et al., 2025b ) . A smaller line of work focuses specifically on compressing or sparsifying the KV cache of autoregressive video diffusion models to reduce attention overhead ( Ji et al., 2026 ; Liu et al., 2026b ; Guo et al., 2026 ) .
However, these methods are generally model-specific, so instead we target other components on the critical path.
Our work builds on state-of-the-art few-step models, but we observe that the iterative denoising process is no longer the latency bottleneck.
blocks.zh:
加快扩散采样. 传播模型需要反复取样(Ho等人,2020年)。 早期的工作减少使用无培训加速采样器的采样步骤(Song等人,2021年;Lu等人,2022年;Lu等人,2025年),或通过培训模型,沿其采样轨迹采取更大的步骤(Frans等人,2025年;Geng等人,2025年;Shaul等人,2026年)。
最新工艺依赖于配给(Yin等人,2024年b; Yin等, 2024a; Cui等, 2026),其中几步学生生成器大致相当于教师网络的分布.
另一行工作侧重于DiTs的推论成本,包括混合关注(Li等,2026;Chen等,2026a),长期背景的滑入窗口关注(Xiao等,2024;Zhang等,2025),以及地层穿透或模型大小分馏(Fang等,2025a; Wu等, 2025b. (原始内容存档于2017-10-29). 更小一行的工作特别侧重于压缩或斯派克(KV)缓存自旋相机视频传播模型,以减少注意力管理费(Ji等,2026;Liu等,2026b;Guo等,2026.).
然而,这些方法一般是针对模型的,因此我们把其他组成部分作为关键路径的目标。
我们的工作建立在最先进的几步模式之上,但我们注意到,迭接解密进程已不再是暂时性的瓶颈。

blocks.en:
Reducing VAE decoding time. State-of-the-art video diffusion models perform diffusion in latent space ( Blattmann et al., 2023 ) , generally encoded via a variational autoencoder (VAE) ( Kingma & Welling, 2014 ) . For instance, the Wan VAE ( Wang et al., 2025 ) can perform up to a 48× reduction in dimensionality.
This makes generation cheaper but pixel decoding becomes expensive. VAE decoders repeatedly upsample features in space and time, and apply dense 3D convolutions at each resolution. For example, a tensor containing four 480×832 frames requires convolution at approximately 1.6 million spatiotemporal positions.
A line of work aims to speed up VAEs ( Boer Bohan, 2023 ; Buzovkin & Shilov, 2025 ) by reducing the number of parameters and removing expensive operations like attention and wide 3D convolutions. These methods gain up to 4× speedup but incur degradation in visual quality ( Boer Bohan, 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) . Instead, we treat the pixel decoder as a lightweight readout specific to a frozen DiT, rather than a general-purpose reconstruction problem. Our pixel head maintains visual quality while being two orders of magnitude faster.
blocks.zh:
缩短VAE解码时间. 最新的视频传播模型在潜在空间进行传播(Blatmann等,2023年),一般通过可变自编码器编码(VAE)(Kingma & Welling,2014年)。 例如,Wan VAE(Wang等,2025年)在维度方面可以达到48×减少。
这使得一代更便宜,但像素解码变得昂贵. VAE解码器在空间和时间上反复地上调出特征,并在每个分辨率上应用密集的3D分解. 例如,装有4个480x832帧的收发机,需要在大约160万个瞬间位置进行回旋.
一条工作线旨在通过减少参数数量并去除关注等昂贵的操作和宽取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取取 这些方法可加速4x,但视觉质量会退化(Boer Bohan,2025;Huang等,2025)。 相反,我们把像素解码器作为冷冻DiT特有的轻量级读取器,而不是通用重建问题. 我们的像素头保持了视觉质量 同时是两个数量级更快。

blocks.en:
Systems-level optimizations. Systems-level techniques accelerate diffusion inference through more efficient scheduling and hardware utilization. Kodaira et al. (2025) and Bandyopadhyay et al. (2026) use batching and pipeline parallelism to improve streaming throughput but do not improve per-frame latency.
StreamDiffusionV2 ( Feng et al., 2026 ) emphasizes non-amortized time-to-first-frame but to the best of our understanding, this metric focuses on the start of a stream, in contrast to our steady-state measurements.
Optimized attention kernels ( Dao, 2024 ) , compilation and operator fusion ( Ansel et al., 2024 ) , and CUDA graph execution ( Ghosh et al., 2025 ) reduce memory traffic and execution overhead. Weight and activation quantization ( Zhao et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2025a ; Su et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026b ) reduce memory requirements and can accelerate computation with suitable hardware support. Distributed inference spreads computation across multiple GPUs through patch, sequence, and pipeline parallelism ( Li et al., 2024 ; Fang et al., 2025b ; Fang et al., 2024 ) .
Our work incorporates many of these techniques.
blocks.zh:
系统级优化. 系统层面的技术通过更有效的调度和硬件利用来加快传播推论. Kodaira等人(2025年)和Bandyopadhyay等人(2026年)利用分批和管线并行性来提高流量的吞吐量,但没有改善每帧的延迟.
StreamDifmusation V2(Feng等,2026年)强调非摊还时间与第一时间框架,但就我们所知,这一衡量标准侧重于溪流的起步,与我们的稳定状态测量相比。
优化关注内核(Dao, 2024),编译和操作员聚变(Ansel等, 2024),和CUDA图执行(Ghosh等, 2025)减少内存流量和执行费. 重量和活性量子化(赵等,2025;李等,2025a; Su等, 2026; Zhao等, 2026b) 降低内存要求并可以通过合适的硬件支持来加速计算. 分布式推论通过补丁、序列和管线平行论在多个GPU之间展开计算(Li等,2024;Fang等,2025b;Fang等,2024.).
我们的工作包含了许多这些技术。

blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Preliminaries: Few-Step Autoregressive Video Diffusion Models
blocks.zh: 3.1 初步情况: 少步自递式视频扩散模型

blocks.en:
Autoregressive (AR) video diffusion models generate a video one latent chunk at a time, using diffusion to synthesize each chunk conditioned on previously generated ones.
We represent a video sequence as 𝒛 1 : N = ( 𝒛 1 , 𝒛 2 , … , 𝒛 N ) {\bm{z}}^{1:N}=({\bm{z}}^{1},{\bm{z}}^{2},\ldots,{\bm{z}}^{N}) , where each chunk 𝒛 i ∈ ℝ C × T × H × W {\bm{z}}^{i}\in\mathbb{R}^{C\times T\times H\times W} contains T ≥ 1 T\geq 1 latent frames with C C channels and spatial resolution H × W H\times W . Each latent frame corresponds to K K RGB frames, where K K is the temporal compression factor of the VAE.
Generating larger chunks (e.g., one chunk = = three latent frames, as in Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) ) is closer to bidirectional models and empirically easier to optimize, while generating a smaller chunk (e.g., one chunk = = one latent frame, as in Causal Forcing++ (CF++) ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) and FastFrames ) is faster.
The joint distribution factorizes autoregressively as p ( 𝒛 1 : N ) = ∏ i = 1 N p ( 𝒛 i ∣ 𝒛 < i ) , p({\bm{z}}^{1:N})=\prod_{i=1}^{N}p({\bm{z}}^{i}\mid{\bm{z}}^{<i}), where 𝒛 < i = ( 𝒛 1 , … , 𝒛 i − 1 ) {\bm{z}}^{<i}=({\bm{z}}^{1},\ldots,{\bm{z}}^{i-1}) denotes the preceding chunks.
Each conditional distribution is modeled by a diffusion transformer (DiT), which generates the next chunk by iteratively denoising an initial noise sample and attends to the preceding chunks via a KV cache.
State-of-the-art models first convert a pretrained bidirectional teacher model into an AR model, and then distill it into a few-step AR student using distribution-matching distillation ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ; Zhu et al., 2026 ) . We refer readers to these works for training details.

blocks.en:
To examine the inference cost, we profile CF++, the fastest few-step AR video diffusion model at the time of writing. It is built on the Wan 2.1 1.3B-parameter backbone. Fig. 2 shows its inference latency on a single B200 GPU, decomposed into three stages: KV-cache updates, diffusion sampling, and pixel rendering.
We use its two-diffusion-step variant, which provides the best speed-quality tradeoff; reducing sampling steps to one significantly degrades visual quality while merely reducing latency by 15%.
Each DiT evaluation takes 41.6 ms using BF16 precision, cuDNN attention backend ( NVIDIA Corporation, 2026 ) , and torch.compile ( Ansel et al., 2024 ) . The KV cache update is an additional DiT evaluation. Finally, the VAE decoder takes 147 ms to decode each generated latent into four RGB frames, resulting in a total end-to-end latency of 271.8 ms.

我们使用其双扩散步骤变体,它提供了最佳的速度质量取舍;将采样步骤降低到一个会显著地降低视觉质量,而仅仅降低15%的延迟。
每次DiT评价需要41.6 ms,使用BF16精度,cuDNN注意后端(NVIDIA Corporation,2026),并使用火炬. 汇编(Ansel等,2024年). KV缓存更新是额外的DiT评价. 最后,VAE解码器需要147 ms来解码每个生成的潜入到4个RGB帧中,结果总的端到端的延迟为271.8 ms.

blocks.en:
This profile suggests that our latency budget of 50 ms leaves room for only a single diffusion sampling step.
Instead, we replace the VAE with lightweight pixel rendering (Sec. 3.2 ) and accelerate KV cache updates (Sec. 3.3 ). Then, by reducing the latency of each DiT evaluation through systems-level optimizations (Sec. 3.4 ), we fit the full inference pipeline within the target latency.
Our final 1.3B model runs in 36 ms on a single B200 GPU, making it 7.6× faster than CF++. Our 14B model runs 10.6× faster than the fastest open-source AR model of the same parameter count and achieves a further 3.5× speedup when distributed across eight B200 GPUs.

我们最终的1.3B型机车在单B200GPU上以36ms运行,使得它比CF++更快. 我们的14B型机车运行速度快于同参数计数中最快的开源AR型机车,并在分布于8个B200GPU时再实现3.5×速度.

blocks.en: 3.2 Removing the VAE Decoder
blocks.zh: 3.2 删除 VAE 解码器

blocks.en:
We first target the VAE decoder since it accounts for more than half of the end-to-end inference latency and alone exceeds our real-time budget 3×.
The VAE decoder only has 73M parameters (compared to the DiT’s 1.3B) but repeatedly upsamples its features in space and time and applies dense 3D convolutions at each resolution. For example, a tensor containing four 480×832 frames requires convolution at approximately 1.6 million spatiotemporal positions.
blocks.zh:
我们首先针对VAE解码器,因为它占到端到端推论延迟的一半以上,单是它就超过了我们的实时预算3×.
VAE解码器只有73M参数(相较于DiT的1.3B),但会再三地对它在空间和时间上的特征进行标出并在每个分辨率上应用密集的三维分解. 例如,装有4个480x832帧的收发机,需要在大约160万个瞬间位置进行回旋.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Comparing pixel decoders. Our pixel decoder (right) renders thin structures and details like hair and raindrops while being two orders of magnitude faster than Wan’s VAE (left). A single linear projection (middle) cannot render sharp outputs, but is sufficient for recognizing the scene and suggests that pixel rendering does not require an expensive decoder.
blocks.zh: 图3:比较像素解码器。 我们的像素解码器(右)使细细的结构和细节像发型和雨滴,同时比Wan的VAE(左)快出两个数量级. 单一的线性投影(middle)不能产生尖锐的输出,但足以识别场景,并暗示像素渲染不需要昂贵的解码器.

blocks.en:
In light of recent advances in pixel diffusion models, we question whether such a decoder is necessary when the DiT already produces rich and spatially contextualized features. For instance, JiT ( Li & He, 2026 ) produces sharp images by mapping between image patches and transformer features using only linear projections.
Thus, we first attempt replacing the VAE with a single linear layer and train it with an MSE loss against the VAE decoded output, keeping the DiT frozen. We found that the outputs were blurry yet recognizable (Fig. 3 ).
blocks.zh:
鉴于像素扩散模型最近的进步,我们怀疑当DiT已经产生丰富和空间背景化的特征时,这种解码器是否必要. 例如,JiT(Li & He, 2026年)通过在图像补丁和变压器特性之间进行映射,只使用线性预测来产生尖锐的图像.
因此,我们首先尝试将VAE替换为单线性地层并用MSE的亏损来对VAE解码输出进行训练,使DiT被冻结. 我们发现产出模糊而可以辨认(图3)。

blocks.en: We then increase the size of the pixel decoder, until arriving at our final architecture consisting of three causal 3D ConvNeXt-style blocks ( Liu et al., 2022 ) . Each block uses a causal 3×3×3 depthwise convolution followed by a channel-mixing MLP. All blocks operate only on the transformer’s low-resolution 21×30×52 token grid. A final linear layer converts each token into a 4×16×16 RGB patch, yielding an 84-frame, 480×832 video. We discard the first three frames following the conventions of the Wan VAE, which does not temporally upsample the first frame. The total number of parameters is comparable (63.9M for ours vs. 73.3M), yet two orders of magnitude faster (1 ms vs. 147 ms).
blocks.zh: 然后,我们增加像素解码器的尺寸,直到我们到达由三个由3D ConvNEXt 风格的块组成的最终建筑(刘等,2022年). 每个块使用因子 3×3×3 深度回转,然后是通道混合 MLP. 所有区块只在变压器的低分辨率21×30×52活字格上运行. 最终的线性地层将每个令牌转换为4×16×16 RGB补丁,产生84-帧,480×832视频. 我们放弃了Wan VAE公约之后的前三个框架,这并没有在时间上提升第一个框架。 参数总数相可比较(我们的63.9M对73.3M),然而两个星等更快(1ms对147ms).

In addition to reducing latency, our pixel decoder is less memory-intensive to optimize. For a batch-size-one, 81-frame
video at 832×480 resolution, a VAE decoder update with BF16 precision and activation checkpointing requires approximately 68 GB of peak GPU memory, compared with approximately 5 GB for our pixel decoder. This makes it practical to optimize the decoder directly in pixel space with adversarial losses to improve sharpness and realism.

blocks.en: 3.3 Faster KV Cache Updates
blocks.zh: 3.3 加快KV 缓存更新

blocks.en:
Autoregressive video diffusion models attend to earlier frames through a KV cache ( Yin et al., 2025 ; Huang et al., 2025 ) .
Each DiT layer maintains its own cache, which holds an attention sink plus a sliding window of recent entries. During each generation, the final denoising pass leaves the current chunk’s cache entries computed from a noisy input. The baselines therefore run an additional DiT pass on the predicted clean latent 𝒛 ^ i \hat{{\bm{z}}}_{i} at t = 0 t=0 and replace those entries with its keys and values (the KV cache write in Fig. 2 ). They discard the pass’s output prediction.
blocks.zh:
自动回放视频传播模型通过KV缓存处理更早的帧(Yin等,2025;Huang等,2025.).
每个 DiT 层维持自己的缓存,该缓存持有一个注意力槽并加上最近条目的滑动窗口. 在每一代人中,最后的解密通过会留下当前块的缓存项,这些项是从噪音输入计算出来的。 因此,基准运行一个额外的 DiT 传递到 t = 0 t = 0 的预想的 excellent z ^ i\ hat{{\bm{ z}}}_{i},并以其密钥和值来替换这些条目(图2中的 KV 缓存写入) 。 他们放弃了通行证的输出预测。

blocks.en:
In a two-step diffusion setup, KV refinement accounts for one-third of DiT evaluations. We first investigate whether refinement is necessary. Naively removing the refinement leads to substantial degradation and training the model to use noisy cached features still produces noticeable artifacts (see supplement for visualizations).
However, we hypothesize that a lightweight network can replace the expensive DiT pass.
We design a KV refinement network with a shared feature extractor and per-layer KV-repair heads. The feature extractor takes 𝒛 ^ i \hat{{\bm{z}}}_{i} and applies the DiT’s frozen patch embedding followed by four lightweight transformer blocks trained from scratch. Each repair head takes these output features and its layer’s noisy keys and values to predict residual corrections.
blocks.zh:
在分两个步骤的传播结构中,KV的完善占了DiT评价的三分之一. 我们首先调查是否需要改进。 自然地去除精度会导致大幅退化,并且训练该模型使用吵闹的缓存地物,仍然会产生出显著的文物(见可视化的补充).
然而,我们假设一个轻量级网络可以取代昂贵的DiT通.
我们设计了一个KV精密网络,有一个共享的特性提取器和每层KV的修复头. 特性提取器需要 z ^ i\ hat → bm{z}}}_{i} 并应用 DiT 被冷冻的补丁嵌入, 然后再从头开始训练出四个轻量级变压器块 。 每个修理头都取出这些输出特征及其层层的响亮键和值来预测剩余校正.

blocks.en:
During training, we freeze the DiT and use the keys and values produced by the original DiT refinement pass to supervise residual corrections to the noisy cache. We train our network with two losses: a direct KV reconstruction loss combining cosine distance and relative ℓ 2 \ell_{2} error, and an attention-output loss that compares the outputs obtained when subsequent chunks attend to the predicted versus target cache.
The network performs comparably to the original refinement pass in terms of quantitative and qualitative comparisons, while taking approximately 2 ms for the 1.3B model and 6 ms for the 14B model on a B200 GPU, around 20× and 12× faster respectively than the baselines’ refinement. We provide details in the supplement.

blocks.en: 3.4 Systems-level Optimizations
blocks.zh: 3.4 系统一级优化

blocks.en:
After reducing non-denoising overhead, DiT evaluations remain the main bottleneck to real-time generation. “Free” optimizations, including faster attention backends and torch.compile() , are already accounted for in the baseline profiling (Fig. 2 ).
First, we observe that the repeated structure of DiT evaluations offers opportunities to reuse computation.
We maintain persistent KV-cache buffers and write new entries directly into their designated slots; precompute and store RoPE tables, text and timestep conditions; and fuse QKV projections into one larger matrix multiplication.
blocks.zh:
DiT评价在减少非被忽略的间接费用后,仍然是主要的瓶颈到实时生成. “自由”优化,包括更快的注意后端和火炬.compile(),已经在基线剖面图中作了说明(图2)。
首先,我们发现,重复的DiT评价结构为再利用计算提供了机会。
我们保留了持久的 KV- cache 缓冲器,并将新条目直接写入其指定的槽; 预先计算和存储 RoPE 表格、文本和时间步条件; 将 QKV 预测导入一个更大的矩阵乘法.

blocks.en:
Second, we find that per-frame AR generation can provide too few query tokens to fully utilize the GPU. We therefore split the KV sequence into segments processed in parallel, then combine their attention outputs using a softmax merge. Concretely, for a full KV cache of length 32,760, we found that splitting it into five segments of 6,552 each led to a 13% latency reduction.
Third, we reduce the overhead of launching and coordinating GPU work via CUDA graphs.
Together, these optimizations bring the DiT evaluation latency from 41.6 ms to 16.4 ms for the 1.3B model on one B200 GPU at the full 32,760-token KV prefix and from 89.2 to 75.6 ms for the 14B model, corresponding to approximately 2.5× and 1.2× speedups.
blocks.zh:
其次,我们发现,每帧AR生成可以提供太多的查询符来充分利用GPU. 因此,我们把KV序列分成平行处理的片段,然后用软马克斯合并来结合它们的注意力输出. 具体地说,对于长度为32,760个的完整的KV缓存,我们发现,将它分为5个部分,每个部分为6,552个部分,导致了13%的耐用性降低.
第三,我们通过CUDA图表减少启动和协调GPU工作的间接费用。
这些优化使得一款B200GPU上的DiT评价潜伏从41.6 ms到16.4 ms,在完全的32,760-token KV前缀,14B模型的DiT评价潜伏从89.2到75.6 ms,对应于约2.5×和1.2×快.

blocks.en:
Next, we distribute computation across 8× B200 GPUs. We experimented with tensor parallelism, attention-head parallelism, KV sharding, joint query–KV partitioning, and context parallelism (CP).
Among them, only CP reduced computation sufficiently to justify communication overhead.
CP partitions query tokens across GPUs and distributes both attention and feed-forward computation, requiring only one exchange of computed keys and values per transformer layer. We implement these exchanges using CUDA-graph-compatible NVLink symmetric-memory gathers. This configuration reduces DiT latency from 16.4 to 5.8 ms for the 1.3B model and from 75.6 to 20.3 ms for the 14B model, corresponding to 2.8× and 3.7× speedups over their optimized single-GPU implementations.
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们将计算分配到8×B200GPU. 我们实验了高压平行主义、注意力头平行主义、KV硬化主义、联合查询-KV分割主义和上下文平行主义。
其中,只有CP降低了计算,足以证明通信间接费用是合理的。
CP分区在GPU之间查询符并同时分配注意力和向反馈计算,每个变压器层只需要一个计算出键和值的交换. 我们使用CUDA-相容的NVLink对称相模集合来进行这些交换. 这种配置将DiT的耐用度从1.3B型的16.4米降低到5.8米,将14B型的耐用度从75.6米降低到20.3米,相对于其最优化的单-GPU执行,对应2.8×和3.7×.

Models and baselines. We build FastFrames on the Wan 2.1 backbone at two model sizes: FastFrames -S with 1.3B parameters and FastFrames -L with 14B.
We initialize FastFrames -S from the two-step Causal Forcing++ (CF++) checkpoint and finetune it using our method. We freeze the DiT and train our pixel decoder and KV refinement network against their respective targets. FastFrames -L required starting from the base bidirectional model. Following the training recipe in CF++, we converted Wan 2.1 14B into an autoregressive model, distilled it into a few-step model, and trained it with DMD. Both FastFrames -S and FastFrames -L perform two-step diffusion sampling and generate one latent frame per autoregressive step.

Quantitative comparisons. Tab. 1 provides a quantitative comparison against bidirectional video generators and autoregressive models. The bidirectional models provide a broader reference for generation quality and latency, while the autoregressive models provide direct comparisons. We report model size, latency, and VBench ( Huang et al., 2024 ) scores. All models are evaluated using the same VBench prompts and seeds.
We report end-to-end latency and compute RPS as its reciprocal in seconds, following the definitions in the introduction. For AR models, one response corresponds to an autoregressive generation unit; for bidirectional models, it corresponds to a complete generated clip. Consequently, RPS does not credit a method for producing multiple frames within one generation unit. We account for diffusion sampling, KV cache updates where applicable, and pixel rendering. For AR models, we measure latency at steady state after warm-up and with a full KV cache. For bidirectional models, we let the model warm up and then generate the configured native clip lengths. All models are evaluated on a B200 GPU unless otherwise specified, at approximately 480p using the model’s officially supported resolutions.

数量比较。 Tab. 1提供了与双向视频生成器和自旋模型的定量比较. 双向模型为生成质量和耐久性提供了更广泛的参考,而自旋模型则提供了直接的比较. 我们报告模型大小,耐久, V Bench(黄等,2024年)的分数。 所有模型都使用同一种V Bench 提示和种子进行评估。
我们按照导言中的定义,逐秒报告端到端的间隔并计算RPS为对等. 对于AR模型,一个响应对应自旋生成单元;对于双向模型,对应一个完整的生成剪辑. 因此,RPS不计入在一代单位内生产多帧的方法。 我们负责扩散采样、 KV 缓存更新和像素渲染。 对于AR模型,我们在取暖后在平稳状态下测量耐久性,并有完整的KV缓存. 对于双向模型,我们让模型取暖后生成所配置的本地剪辑长度. 除非另有说明,所有模型都用B200 GPU进行评价,使用该模型官方支持的分辨率大约为480p。

blocks.en: We find that FastFrames matches corresponding baselines with the same Wan 2.1 backbone (Krea-Realtime vs. FastFrames -L, CF++ vs. FastFrames -S). Between FastFrames -S and CF++, which use the same DiT weights, we attribute the higher visual quality to end-to-end adversarial training in pixel space, which boosts realism and sharpness.
blocks.zh: 我们发现FastFrames与同为Wan 2.1的主干线(Krea-Realtime vs. FastFrames -L,CF++ vs. FastFrames -S)相匹配相应的基线. FastFrames -S和CF++之间,使用相同的DiT重量,我们把更高的视觉质量归结为像素空间的端到端对抗训练,这增强了现实性和锐度.

blocks.en: None of the baselines meet the 50 ms latency target required for interactive applications. The fastest baseline, CF++, reaches 3.68 RPS at 272 ms, falling 5.4× short of the 20 RPS target. In contrast, FastFrames -S attains a latency of 36 ms (27.8 RPS) on a single B200 GPU and FastFrames -L attains 45 ms (22.2 RPS) on an 8-GPU node. FastFrames -S on 8 GPUs reaches 14 ms (71.4 RPS), while FastFrames -L on a single GPU reaches 158 ms (6.33 RPS).
blocks.zh: 任何基线都达不到交互式应用程序所需的50ms延迟目标。 最快的基准CF++在272 ms时达到3.68 RPS,比20 RPS目标相差5.4×. 相形之下,FastFrames - S在一个单一的B200 GPU和FastFrames上达到36 ms(27.8 RPS)的耐用度-L在一个8-GPU节点上达到45 ms(22.2 RPS). FastFrames-S在8个GPU上达到14 ms(71.4 RPS),而FastFrames-L在单个GPU上达到158 ms(6.33 RPS).

blocks.en: Qualitative comparisons. Fig. 4 shows a side-by-side comparison between FastFrames -S, FastFrames -L, and their respective baselines. FastFrames -S maintains visual sharpness relative to CF++, capturing fine details like sculptures and leaves while being nearly 8× faster. FastFrames -L achieves realism, prompt adherence, composition, and text rendering capabilities comparable to Krea-Realtime while being over 10× faster.
blocks.zh: 质相相相取. 图4显示了FastFrames-S,FastFrames-L及其各自的基线之间的并列比较. FastFrames - S保持了相对于CF++的视觉锐度,捕捉出像雕塑和叶片等细细细节,同时速度也接近8×. FastFrames - L实现现实主义,即时遵守,组成,以及文本渲染能力与克蕾亚-Realtime相比,同时快于10×.

blocks.en: Fig. 4 also illustrates the improved capabilities of the 14B models relative to their 1.3B counterparts. The larger models produce more realistic lighting and shadows in the first two examples, better capture the folded-paper appearance of the origami dragon in the third, and render more legible text in the fourth. We encourage readers to view the supplementary videos on the project website .

blocks.en:
Interactive applications. We showcase FastFrames in interactive settings by accelerating camera-conditioned and physics-conditioned video generation: LingBot ( Gao et al., 2026 ) , a family of camera-conditioned video models with 1.3B and 14B variants, and RealWonder ( Liu et al., 2026c ) , a 1.3B physics-conditioned video model.
Our techniques transfer directly to these off-the-shelf models and yield large speedups, even over official code that already includes optimizations such as Ulysses sequence parallelism ( Jacobs et al., 2024 ) . Fig. 5 summarizes the latency profiles.

互动应用. 我们通过加速相机和物理相机的视频生成,在互动环境中展示FastFrames: 灵灵 Bot (Gao等,2026年),由1.3B和14B变体组成的相机条件视频模型家族;而Real Wonder (Liu等,2026c),是1.3B物理条件视频模型.
我们的技术直接转移到这些现成的模型上,并产生出巨大的速度,甚至超过官方代码,这些代码已经包括了尤利西斯序列平行主义等优化(Jacobs等,2024年). 图5概述了延迟情况。

blocks.en:
On LingBot 1.3B, we reduce latency from 842 ms (the fastest official configuration, 2 GPUs) to 52 ms on 8 GPUs, a 16× speedup. On RealWonder, latency drops from 1141 ms (official, 1 GPU) to 51 ms (22×), so both models approximately reach our target interactive latency. On LingBot 14B, latency drops from 1373 ms to 233 ms on 8 GPUs (5.9×).
These models remain slower than our T2V models because they require more diffusion sampling steps, predict multiple latent frames per autoregressive step, and need extra DiT computation to process additional conditioning.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We presented FastFrames , a family of autoregressive video diffusion models that achieves interactive latency by rethinking components of the inference pipeline often treated as fixed implementation details. Both our 1.3B and 14B variants achieve generation quality comparable to or better than their respective baselines.
blocks.zh: FastFrames是一个自递式视频传播模式的家族,通过重新思考通常被视为固定执行细节的推论管道的组件,实现互动性延缓。 我们的1.3B和14B变体的生成质量都与各自的基线相当或更好。

blocks.en: While our evaluation focuses on text-to-video generation at 480p on high-end GPUs, important directions for future work include adding action conditioning without increasing latency, scaling to higher resolutions, and supporting lighter hardware form factors. Improving long-term consistency and physical plausibility will further broaden the utility of video world models.
blocks.zh: 虽然我们的评价集中在高端GPU上480p的文本到视频生成,但未来工作的重要方向包括增加动作条件而不增加耐用性,缩放到更高的分辨率,支持更轻的硬件形式因素. 提高长期一致性和物理可信度将进一步扩大视频世界模型的效用.

blocks.en: Appendix A Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 附录A 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: Resolution. Most baselines and base video models use 480p resolution, which we finetune from. Higher resolution like 720p or even 4K is desired for a variety of applications like gaming and content creation. In the next section, we find that increasing resolution to 720p increases latency significantly; further optimization is required to bring high-res video generation into the interactive regime.
blocks.zh: 决议。 大多数基线和基础视频模型使用480p分辨率,我们从中微调. 更高分辨度如720p甚至4K,对于游戏和内容创建等多种应用都是所期望的. 在下一节中,我们发现将分辨率提高到720p会大大增加耐用性;需要进一步优化,以便将高收视率的视频生成带入互动系统.

blocks.en: Accessible hardware. We use B200 GPUs for our latency measurements in the main paper. While we assume compute will continue to become cheaper and more accessible, being able to run interactive video models on-device is an exciting possibility.
blocks.zh: 无障碍硬件. 我们用B200GPU在主纸中进行耐久测量. 虽然我们假设计算会继续变得更便宜,更方便使用,但能够在设备上运行交互式视频模型是一个令人振奋的可能性.

blocks.en: Action conditions designed for lower latency. We applied FastFrames to off-the-shelf autoregressive models that were slower than their T2V counterparts. Training base models with lower latency in mind, such as concatenating camera poses in the channel dimension rather than the sequence dimension, without compromising quality, is essential for reducing latency.
blocks.zh: 为更低的延迟设计动作条件. 我们把FastFrames应用到现成的自递式模型上,这些模型比他们的T2V对等器慢. 具有较低耐用性的培训基础模型,如相机在通道维度而不是序列维度中摆出相机相机,在不影响质量的情况下,对于降低耐用性至关重要.

blocks.en:
Some baselines like Self-Forcing ( Huang et al., 2025 ) report latency in their paper. However, we did not find detailed descriptions or breakdowns of those numbers and can only infer their profiling from source code. We found that Self-Forcing measured latency by generating a video sequence of N latent chunks (where each chunk ≥ \geq 1 latent frame(s)), then dividing the total time by the number of chunks. However, earlier chunks are faster to generate due to an initially empty KV cache that gradually fills, so this average does not represent steady-state latency at long contexts.
Occasionally, baselines provide ambiguous latency numbers without explanation; Causal Forcing++ ( Zhao et al., 2026a ) reports 270 ms for its 1, 2, and 4 step models without explanation.

一些基线,如自强(Huang等,2025年)在其论文中报告了延缓性. 但是,我们没有找到这些数字的详细描述或分类,只能从源代码推断出其特征。 我们发现,“自强制”通过生成N潜在块的视频序列(每个块 \\ geq 1 潜在框)来测量耐久性,然后将总时间除以块数。 然而,由于KV缓存最初是空的而逐渐被填充,所以更早的块生成速度更快,因此这个平均值并不代表长上下文中的稳态延迟.
有时,基线提供不确定的延迟数字而不作解释;Causal Forcing++ (Zhao等,2026a)报告其1,2和4个阶梯型号为270毫秒而未作解释.

blocks.zh: 附录 C 像素解码器的建筑和培训细节

blocks.en:
Our pixel decoder is a causal ConvNeXt model operating directly on the pre-head features of the frozen two-step DiTs. For a 21-frame latent sequence, the DiT produces 32,760 tokens on a ( 21 × 30 × 52 21\times 30\times 52 ) spatiotemporal grid with channel width 1536. The head applies per-frame adaptive shift/scale modulation, a ( 1 × 1 1\times 1 ) channel projection, and three ConvNeXt-style causal 3D residual blocks—two low-resolution blocks followed by one output block—using depthwise ( 3 × 3 × 3 3\times 3\times 3 ) convolutions, channel-wise layer normalization, and width-4 pointwise GELU expansions. All convolutional processing remains at the DiT token resolution; the selected configuration has no learned temporal or spatial upsampler, latent adapter, displacement branch, auxiliary feature fusion, or post-RGB refiner. A final per-token linear projection maps the 1536-dimensional features to ( 4 × 16 × 16 × 3 4\times 16\times 16\times 3 ) RGB values, which are unpatchified into 84 frames at ( 480 × 832 480\times 832 ) and aligned to
the VAE convention by dropping the first three frames, yielding 81 output frames. The decoder contains 63.87M parameters and is causal in time, so each output block
depends only on the current and preceding latent blocks.

blocks.en: Appendix D Architecture and Training Details of KV Refinement Network
blocks.zh: 附录D KV完善网络的建筑和培训细节

blocks.en: As described in the main paper, we first investigate whether KV refinement is necessary, given that the last diffusion sampling step writes a noisy KV cache for free. In Fig. 6 , we find that removing KV refinement, even after training the model to learn to use the noisy KV cache, leads to drift and artifacts. These experiments motivate our design.
blocks.zh: 正如主要论文所描述的,我们首先调查KV的改进是否必要,因为最后一个扩散采样步骤是免费写出一个吵闹的KV缓存. 在图6中,我们发现删除 KV的精细化, 即使训练模型 学习使用吵闹的 KV 缓存, 会导致漂移和文物。 这些实验激励了我们的设计。

blocks.en: Our KV refinement network is a cache-repair module that replaces the expensive DiT evaluation of the baselines. Each DiT layer maintains its own KV cache, partitioned into one slice for each generated latent frame. During every diffusion evaluation for frame i i , the KV tensors for that frame overwrite its current cache slice, while the slices for earlier frames remain available as causal context. At the final denoising step, the DiT still receives a nonzero-noise latent, although it predicts the clean latent 𝒛 0 {\bm{z}}_{0} ; consequently, the KV written to the current slice correspond to the noisy input. The baseline therefore performs an additional, non-denoising DiT forward pass on 𝒛 0 {\bm{z}}_{0} with zero-noise time conditioning ( t = 0 t=0 ), overwriting the same slice with clean-context KV.
blocks.zh: 我们的KV改进网络是一个缓存-修复模块,取代了昂贵的DiT对基线的评价. 每个 DiT 层维持自己的 KV 缓存, 每个生成的潜在框架被分割成一个切片 。 在每一次对帧一的传播评价中,该帧的KV亮度会覆盖其当前缓存切片,而早期帧的切片作为因果关系仍然可用. 在最后的去诺步骤上,DiT仍然接收到一个非零噪的潜在,尽管它预言着干净的潜在z $0 ~bm{z}}_{0};因此,写给当前切片的KV对应了响亮的输入. 因此,基准在零噪分时(t = 0 t = 0)的z 0 ~bm{z}}_{0}上执行额外的非去除的 DiT 前传,用干净的折叠克V来覆盖同一切片.

blocks.en:
Instead, our network consumes the noisy K/V tensors from the final denoising pass together with the predicted 𝒛 0 {\bm{z}}_{0} , predicts corrected K/V tensors, and overwrites the same cache slice.
Subsequent latent frames therefore attend to the repaired context without requiring the additional full DiT forward pass.
A shared stem maps the 1,560 patch tokens per frame from 1,536 to 768 channels, then applies four lightweight 8-head spatial self-attention blocks with 4× GELU MLPs and timestep-conditioned adaptive layer normalization. Each of the DiT layers has a separate repair head that projects its noisy K/V, concatenates them with the shared per-token 𝒛 0 {\bm{z}}_{0} features, and predicts residual corrections. Keys are corrected in post-RoPE space and renormalized per attention head, while values receive a learned residual and per-channel scale. All residual outputs are zero-initialized so the adapter initially behaves like the no-prime baseline.
blocks.zh:
相反,我们的网络消耗了来自最终解密的 K/V 百分位数, 加上预想的 z 0 \bm{z}}_{0}, 预测修正的 K/V 百分位数, 并覆盖相同的缓存切片 。
因此,随后的潜在框架处理已修复的上下文,而不需要额外的完整的DiT前行通行证。
共享干线图1,560个补丁符号从1,536道到768道,然后应用4个轻量级8头空间自留区块,并配有4×GELU MLP和有时间步态的适应层正常化. DiT层的每个层都有一个单独的修复头来投射其吵闹的K/V,并用共享的每托肯的z $bm{z}}_{0}特征来调和它们,并预测剩余校正. 密钥在ROPE后空间被校正,每个注意力头重新正常化,而值则得到一个学习到的剩余和每个通道的尺度. 所有剩余输出都是零初始化的,因此适配器最初表现得类似于无优先基准.

blocks.en: During inference, frame 0 retains a real clean-prime anchor, while subsequent frames use the repaired K/V to overwrite their cache slots before the next frame is processed. The adapter is trained with the DiT and VAE frozen using teacher-forced targets from the real prime pass: the primary objective matches future attention outputs, supplemented by direct K/V reconstruction with approximately three times more weight on value than key errors, since we found that value corruption dominates the degradation.
blocks.zh: 在推论期间,帧0保留了真正的清洁主锚,而后帧则使用已修复的K/V来覆盖其缓存槽后再处理下帧. 适配器被用从真实的质谱开始的由教师强制的目标来进行DiT和VAE被冻结的训练:主要目标与未来的关注产出相匹配,辅之以直接的K/V重建,其价值比关键错误的比重高出大约三倍,因为我们发现价值腐败主导了退化.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : KV refinement ablation. Autoregressive baselines refine the KV cache using an additional DiT evaluation, which is costly but effective. Removing that refinement naively (third column) substantially degrades the scene’s consistency; the objects in the scenes change over time. Even training without the refinement (fourth column) does not fix the problem. Either the subject changes over time (the face changes in the second example), or noticeable artifacts appear (clothing in the first example, fingers in the second example). Our KV refinement network (second column) replaces the DiT evaluation and performs equally while being an order of magnitude faster.

blocks.en: Appendix E Adaptation Details of Interactive Applications
blocks.zh: 附录E 互动应用程序的适应细节

blocks.en: We use the official model and weights released by the authors. We follow the procedure described in Sec. 3 to train both the pixel decoder and the KV refinement network. Neither component requires large-scale training data. We simply roll out the models to create target pixels and clean keys and values on-the-fly.
blocks.zh: 我们使用作者们发布的官方模型和重量. 我们遵循Sec. 3中描述的程序来训练像素解码器和KV精密网络. 两个组成部分都需要大规模培训数据。 我们只是推出模型 创建目标像素 和干净的钥匙 和价值在飞行。

blocks.en:
LingBot requires four diffusion sampling steps per autoregressive generation, and generates four latent frames at once. RealWonder requires three sampling steps and generates three latent frames at once. Both are substantially more expensive than our setup in FastFrames , which performs two sampling steps, and generates one latent frame at a time. Thus, even the 1.3B models require 8 GPUs to reach interactive latency.
RealWonder is slower than LingBot at the same parameter count due to its more expensive processing of its action conditions.
Distilling these models to fewer steps and fewer latent frames per generation while maintaining output quality and adherence to conditions is important future work.
blocks.zh:
灵灵 瓶子每自旋生成需要四个扩散采样步骤,并同时生成四个潜在帧. RealWonder需要三个采样步骤,并同时生成三个潜在帧. 两者都比我们在 FastFrames 的设置昂贵得多, 因此,即使是1.3B模型,都需要8个GPU才能达到交互延后.
RealWonder由于对动作条件的处理费用较高,在同一个参数计数时比LingBot慢.
在保持产出质量和遵守条件的同时,将这些模型分散到每代人的步骤和潜在框架都更少,这是今后的重要工作。
